logic: Base 18% CAGR trails 5Y 27% and 3Y 21% history; Rs 2,964 Cr book (~2.1x sales) + 30% of Rs 3,083 Cr pipeline converts.
Bear = BFSI capex pause + hardware-mix margin slip + derate to 12x. Bull = AI-ready DC + SOC-led annuity surge, P/E held at 22x.
Key insight: EPS spread Rs 80 -> Rs 220 (~2.7x) vs price spread Rs 964 -> Rs 4,832 (~5.0x) — the multiple does the heavy lifting.
Monitor quarterly: order inflow vs pipeline conversion, managed-services mix vs 21%, OPM vs 11%, debtor days vs 154, borrowings vs Rs 237 Cr.

takeaway: Dynacons Systems & Solutions doesn't sell servers — it sells working BFSI infrastructure with someone to run it, and the filings say the next chapter is converting a Rs 2,964 Cr order book into annuity services — integrated in Mumbai, delivered across 300+ locations, trusted by the RBI and SBI.

big_messages: FY26 margin break: EBITDA +38% on +12% sales, OPM 8.8% -> 10.7% on services mix
Rs 2,964 Cr book (~2.1x sales) + Rs 3,083 Cr pipeline at ~30% win = multi-year visibility
Annuity pivot: managed services ~21% of revenue; DaaS/SOC deals run 5-7 years
red_flags: Client concentration: top-5 = 33% of revenue; top-10 historically 48-60%
Cash conversion thin: debtor days 154-155; FY26 CFO/OP 32%, FCF ~Rs 3 Cr
Leverage rising: borrowings Rs 36 Cr (FY24) -> Rs 237 Cr (FY26); bank guarantees constrain
Hardware-mix margin risk: Q4 FY26 sales +22% but PAT only +4%; OPM still ~11%
Lumpy PSU ordering: Q1 FY27 sales -4.6% YoY; book converts only if execution holds
trends: Order-book scale-up: Rs 2,389 Cr (Dec-25) -> Rs 2,964 Cr (May-26) on BFSI/PSU wins
Annuity mix: DaaS + SD-WAN + SOC contracts lock 5-7 year recurring revenue
AI-ready DC + cloud: HCI/hybrid + automation demand from BFSI modernisation
Margin defence: 11% OPM must hold as hardware-heavy orders convert
Competition: Orient (+39% FY25) and Allied scale the same SI pond

valuation.methodology: AlphaSpread primary live 27 Sep 2026 — DCF Rs 1,324.18 (Net Income template, 7yr, Rev 15.5% vs 5Y hist 26.7%, Net margin 5.9%->4.8% vs hist 4.7%, Discount 11%, Terminal 0%) + Multiples-Based Rs 1,595.90 -> equal-weight Intrinsic Rs 1,460.04, Buy Rs 1,168.03. Local cross-check: trailing 15.3x, P/B 4.1x, OPM 11% TTM.
